faq_q1: Where does the AI Assistant get its answers?
faq_a1: The AI Assistant extracts all answers exclusively from the official text of UHB Study Regulations and Student Discipline Regulations.
faq_q2: Is the AI Assistant's answer an official decision?
faq_a2: No. The AI response is for clarification and guidance only. The official decision is always issued by the Deanship of Student Affairs and relevant academic departments.
faq_q3: What if I can't find an answer to my question?
faq_a3: You can use the support card below to submit your query directly to the relevant department or report inaccurate answers.
faq_q4: Are my conversations with the AI Assistant saved?
faq_a4: Conversations are retained for quality improvement and statistical analysis only, without sharing any personally identifiable student data.
faq_q5: How can I report inaccurate information?
faq_a5: Via the support card at the bottom of the page — click 'Report Inaccurate Information' and specify the issue for immediate review.
